# DeepSeek Harness

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by [DeepSeek AI](https://deepseek.com).

It is built on an **everything-is-a-plugin** architecture and powered by [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis), whose design is described in [_A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25512).

Documentation: [https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)

## Developer preview

DeepSeek Harness is in _developer preview_ and iterating rapidly. **THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES.**

Review the [safety notice](SAFETY.md) before running the project.

## Run

### Run from `npm`

Install `Node.js`, then run:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

The command starts the Web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080` by default and opens it in the default browser for a local launch. An SSH launch only prints the host URL because the SSH client or editor owns the local forwarded address. Pass `--no-open` to run the server without opening a browser. See [Web UI guide](docs/user/guide/index.md).

### Run from source

To run from a repository checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

`pnpm run build` prepares the repository artifacts. `pnpm dsh web` uses those built artifacts without rebuilding.

## Community and support

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# Context Mode

**The other half of the context problem.**

Used across teams at

## The Problem

Every MCP tool call dumps raw data into your context window. A Playwright snapshot costs 56 KB. Twenty GitHub issues cost 59 KB. One access log — 45 KB. After 30 minutes, 40% of your context is gone. And when the agent compacts the conversation to free space, it forgets which files it was editing, what tasks are in progress, and what you last asked for. On top of that, the agent wastes output tokens on filler, pleasantries, and verbose explanations — burning context from both sides.

### How Context Mode Solves It

Context Mode is an MCP server that solves all four sides of this problem:

1. **Context Saving** — Sandbox tools keep raw data out of the context window. 315 KB becomes 5.4 KB. 98% reduction.
2. **Session Continuity** — Every file edit, git operation, task, error, and user decision is tracked in SQLite. When the conversation compacts, context-mode doesn't dump this data back into context — it indexes events into FTS5 and retrieves only what's relevant via BM25 search. The model picks up exactly where you left off. If you don't `--continue`, previous session data is deleted immediately — a fresh session means a clean slate.
3. **Think in Code** — The LLM should program the analysis, not compute it. Instead of reading 50 files into context to count functions, the agent writes a script that does the counting and `console.log()`s only the result. One script replaces ten to

Plan your week, run guided workouts, log every set and your body weight,

## Why openGym

Most workout apps keep your data on their servers, push you towards a subscription, or vanish
when the company does. openGym runs on your own box, keeps your data in a folder you control, and

**An agent meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex.**

##  Get started with Ruflo

 **Start in Claude Code** with core tools, the visual console and runtime mods. Requires Claude Code **2.1.287 or later**. Run inside Claude Code:

```text
/plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo
/plugin install ruflo-core@ruflo
/plugin install ruflo-console@ruflo
/plugin install ruflo-mods@ruflo
/reload-plugins
/ruflo
```

**Core** provides foundation tools. **Console** opens the agent cockpit. **Mods** add routing and policy enforcement inside Claude Code. Mods run with your account's permissions; review their code before installing.

 **Using Codex or another MCP enabled tool?** Use NPX for Ruflo project setup and connect your client to the Ruflo MCP server. Run the setup wizard in your project terminal:

```bash
npx ruflo@latest init wizard
```

For clients that support local stdio MCP servers, configure **command** `npx` and **arguments** `["-y", "ruflo@latest", "mcp", "start"]`. The equivalent server command is:

```bash
npx -y ruflo@latest mcp start
```

MCP exposes Ruflo tools to your client. The console and mods above are Claude Code integrations; hook support depends on the client.

 **Prefer a plain terminal? Optional.** The console also runs on its own, with no Claude Code: `npx ruflo tui` (add `--plain` to print one frame for scripts). It shows Overview, Cost, Swarm, Events and Missions, plus an optional AI page. [Terminal UI guide](docs/USERGUIDE.md#terminal-ui-optional)

# CoCo Super Intelligence

495 personas across 13 departments, **228 skills**[^installed] and **387 commands** in the full catalog (coco main, 2026-10-05).

  
  

Open-core: the core is [MIT](LICENSE), and Super Intelligence is [proprietary](systems/superintelligence/LICENSE). Files stay on your machine. No telemetry. A version check may contact GitHub once a day.

## Why it exists

A hard call in a coding session usually gets one model's opinion, with no name on it and no record of who disagreed. CoCo seats a cross-team board of 495 personas, each modeled on the public writing of a named expert, answering from cited public stances, and returns one pick plus the dissent. They are not those people's views or endorsement. The same install carries the skills and commands that do the work after the verdict, and writes phase state to disk so a cleared chat does not erase the plan. It is not a new model and not a new harness. It installs into the one you already run.

- Optional code execution, web search, MCP, inference guardrails, and file understanding

# CoCo Super Intelligence

495 personas across 13 departments, **228 skills**[^installed] and **387 commands** in the full catalog (coco main, 2026-10-05).

  
  

Open-core: the core is [MIT](LICENSE), and Super Intelligence is [proprietary](systems/superintelligence/LICENSE). Files stay on your machine. No telemetry. A version check may contact GitHub once a day.

## Why it exists

A hard call in a coding session usually gets one model's opinion, with no name on it and no record of who disagreed. CoCo seats a cross-team board of 495 personas, each modeled on the public writing of a named expert, answering from cited public stances, and returns one pick plus the dissent. They are not those people's views or endorsement. The same install carries the skills and commands that do the work after the verdict, and writes phase state to disk so a cleared chat does not erase the plan. It is not a new model and not a new harness. It installs into the one you already run.

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
Git designed for AI agents.

Anthropic built **Scion**, a faster version control system for coding agents,
and described it in
[Redesigning source control](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/redesigning-source-control):
a server-centric system built for hundreds of agents that read, write and land
code at the same time. Scion is internal to Anthropic and is not available to
the public.

So I built **gitai**: an open-source version of that design that anyone can
run, and that the community can improve and maintain together.

MIT licensed. Vendor neutral: the server never calls a language model, and every
AI feature works with any provider, or none.

gitai is an independent implementation of the publicly described design. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

---

## Why

Classic Git hosting was built for humans who clone a repository, work for hours
and push once. Coding agents work differently: thousands of short-lived tasks,
each touching a few files, each wanting to land in seconds, all on the same
branches. Full clones, merge queues and client-side history walks become the
bottleneck.

Scion's answer is to move the work to the server: clients stay online and fetch
only what they need, history questions are answered (and cached) by the server,
changes land through a compare-and-swap instead of a queue, every update is an
entry in a changeset log, and the repository state lives in a consistent
database plus object storage so servers scale out. gitai impleme

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# earshot

**Ears for coding agents.**

[**Watch the 22 s launch film**](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot/releases/tag/v0.1.0) - every sound in it was made
in code by `earshot forge`; no recordings, no music track.

AI coding agents can now write the code that renders a film, a product demo or a game. They still cannot hear what
they made. They cannot tell a premium key press from a cheap one, notice that a hit lands 80 ms after the cut, or
hear that the music swells in the wrong place.

earshot turns sound into evidence an agent can reason about: what a file sounds like in words, how well it fits a
description, the best moment inside a long recording, whether it is a real recording or code-synthesized, a
second-by-second listening transcript of a whole film, an annotated picture of it, and a scorecard against
professional launch films. It runs locally on CPU, as a CLI, a Python API and an MCP server.

With ears, an agent can also **make its own sounds in code** and improve them by listening (`earshot forge`), and
**translate a recording into code** it can vary (`earshot fit`). Both below.

# leanrea

**One 8 KB skill file that does what [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea) does: no MCP server, no 207 tools, no setup.**

REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) puts an MCP layer between your agent and tools it can already use: asar, otool, nm, `go version -m`, jadx, apktool, Ghidra, tshark, binwalk, sqlite3. leanrea drops that layer. |  | REA 6.5.0 | leanrea |
|---|---|---|
| What gets installed | 25 MB npm package + MCP server | one `SKILL.md` |
| Instructions | 23.5 KB skill + 48.8 KB references | 8 KB |
| Tools added to the agent | 207 (3.35 MB of definitions) | 0 (uses Bash) |

Claude Code headless (`claude -p`), Sonnet 5.5, macOS arm64. 4 reverse-engineering tasks × 3 reps × 3 arms, with the arms run side by side. Answers are graded against hand-made keys.

| REA (MCP + its skill) | 627 s | $3.36 | 124 | 5.93 M | 75/75 |

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# imozuru

  
  

日本語 | [English](README.en.md)

imozuruは、知らない分野を、原文にたどりつくまで芋づる式に掘るClaude Codeのスキルです。
Batesのberrypicking、Ellisの探索行動のモデル、Kuhlthauの探索過程の研究など、図書館情報学の情報探索の研究から、考え方を応用しています。

## ふつうに頼んだときとの違い

スキルなしで「調べて」と頼むと、LLMは検索上位の数件を読んで要約を返します。
要約はすぐに読めますが、判断に必要な細部が落ちやすい欠点を抱えています。
分野の用語を知らないうちは検索語も選べないため、最初に思いついた言葉の範囲から先へ進めません。

imozuruはまず分野の用語、中心にいる人、知見が集まる場を押さえ、そこから引用やリンク、著者をたどって原文を集めます。
集めた原文は要約せずに保存し、答えに必要な主張ごとに「どのファイルの何行目か」を示すに留まります。
原文を読んで判断するのは、ユーザー自身です。

## 動き方

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[問いと要る主張を書く] --> B[地図づくり用語・人・場]
    B --> C[たどる引用・リンク・著者]
    C --> D[原文を落とす]
    D --> E{要る主張に原文が付いた？}
    E -- まだ --> C
    E -- 付いた・飽和した --> F[抜き書きのページを作る]
```

Claudeはまず、問いと、答えるために必要な主張を3〜6個書き出します。
次に、探し方を変えた2本の検索役（Webを検索するサブエージェント）で用語、人、場を集め、地図（`map.md`）にまとめます。
その後、原文が見つかるまで参考文献や被引用、著者をたどっていきます。
論文のない分野では、記事の中のリンクや「〇〇さんの記事を参考にした」という記述をたどります。

見つけた原文は `sources/` に保存し、404やログインを求めるページは中身を見て除きます。
すべての主張に原文が付くか、新しい資料が出てこなくなったら探すのをやめます。
最後に、原文から切り出した文を主張ごとに並べたページ（抜き書きのページ）を作ります。

見張りのモードでは、掘って見つけた場（QiitaやZennのタグ、note、YouTube、ブログ、arXiv）の新着をRSSで集めて並べます。

## 入れ方

[skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) のCLIで入れられます。

```sh
npx skills add MaryCache/imozuru
```

手動の場合は、`skills/imozuru/` を `~/.claude/skills/imozuru/` にコピーしてください。

## 必要なもの

スクリプトはPython 3.10以上の標準ライブラリだけで動き、次のコマンドは入っていれば使います。

| コマンド | 使う場面 | 入っていない場合 |
|---|---|---|
| `pdftotext`（popplerかXpdf） | PDFから本文を取り出す | PDFの本文が取れず `FAIL` になる |
| `pdftoppm`（popplerかXpdf）と `tesseract` | 文字の層がない古いPDFをOCRにかける | そのPDFは `FAIL` になる |

# mcd-party-planner · 麦当劳聚会 / 团餐组织助手

> 基于 **麦当劳 MCP** 真实能力的 Skill：输入「城市 + 关键词 + 人数 + 预算」，
> 输出多套**真实计价**的团餐方案；串联主题活动（派对 / 品鉴会）预约链路；
> 结合活动日历与附近门店给出组织时机建议。
>
> 参赛作品 —— 麦当劳程序员节创意开发大赛（2026 · 1024 程序员节）。

---

## 一、项目介绍

组织一次多人麦当劳聚餐，真正麻烦的不是点什么，而是三件事同时算清楚：**附近哪家门店能吃、多少人吃什么组合、总共花多少钱不超预算**。

`mcd-party-planner` 把这三件事交给麦当劳 MCP 的真实数据（共接入 **15 个 Tool**）：

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **团餐方案生成** | 查附近营业中门店 → 拉真实菜单 → 按「经济型 / 均衡型 / 丰盛型」组装 → 用 `calculate-price` 真实计价，输出 ≥2 套含「合计 / 人均 / 是否超预算」的可比对方案 |
| **主题活动预约** | 自动串联 `派对商品 → 城市 → 门店 → 日期 → 场次` 五级查询，输出可直接下单的载荷；**默认 dry_run，不真实下单** |
| **活动日历组织建议** | 活动日历（往期 / 今日 / 未来）× 附近门店交叉，给出组织时机建议，并提示企业团餐助餐服务可用性 |

设计原则：**数据全部实时取自麦当劳 MCP，仓库内不含任何静态菜单或价格快照**；用户输入（城市、关键词、人数、预算）仅存在于运行时内存，不落盘、不外发。

> 调用层内置滑动窗口节流器（默认 300 次/分钟，官方上限 600）与 429 指数退避，批量比对不会触发限流。

---

## 二、安装方法

### 1. 申请 MCP Token

访问 [麦当劳 MCP 开放平台](https://open.mcd.cn/mcp) → 手机号验证登录 → 右上角「控制台」→「激活」→ 同意服务协议 → 复制 Token。

### 2. 获取代码

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zcbacxc/mcd-party-planner.git
cd mcd-party-planner
```

### 3. 配置 Token

```bash
cp .env.example .env
# 编辑 .env，填入：MCD_MCP_TOKEN=你的Token
```

> `.env` 已被 `.gitignore` 排除，**绝不会提交到仓库**。仓库中的 `mcp-config.example.json` 只含环境变量占位符。

### 4. 在 WorkBuddy 中使用（可选）

本项目主交付形态即 WorkBuddy Skill（见 [`skill/SKILL.md`](./skill/SKILL.md)）。按 `mcp-config.example.json` 在 WorkBuddy 的【自定义连接器】中启用 `mcd-mcp` 后，直接用自然语言描述聚餐需求即可。

### 5. 环境要求

- Python 3.9 及以上，**仅依赖标准库，无需 pip 安装任何包**。

### 6. 自检

```bash
python -m src.cli selfcheck
```

**AI 跨境电商运营智能体工具箱** · *Turn cross-border ecommerce SOPs into reusable AI Agent workflows.*

---

## 这是什么

把**跨境运营 SOP 里沉淀的经验**，翻译成**可复制的 AI Agent 工作流**：一个标准 Prompt + 一份输入模板 + 一个真实案例，任何人都能拿去直接跑出可发布的商品素材。

不是软件，不是 SaaS，只做四件事：

| 交付物 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 📘 运营方法论 | SOP 章节 → Agent 模块的完整拆解表 |
| 🧠 AI Prompt | 角色 / 任务 / 输入契约 / 输出契约 / 自检 |
| 🔁 工作流程 | 什么顺序跑、什么条件进入下一步、什么条件回流重改 |
| 📄 模板 + 案例 | 标准输入格式 + 真实产品的完整跑通记录（含复测数据） |

**为什么做这个**：跨境运营的难点不是"不知道要做什么"，而是"知道但做不出稳定下限的产出"。同一个类目，老手写标题一次到位，新人写十遍还是堆词。这套工具箱的目标是把老手的**判断规则**结构化，让 AI 的产出稳定在老手水平线上。

# cc-stretch

**Claude writes a lot. Now you can read a little.**

Replies arrive short. Click a linked phrase and it grows right where it stands. Click `«` and it
shrinks back. Claude is told which parts you opened, so it doesn't assume you read the rest.

## Install

In a Claude Code session:

```
/plugin install cc-stretch --marketplace pro-vi/cc-stretch
/tui fullscreen
```

In the terminal, clicks need Claude Code's fullscreen renderer. `/tui fullscreen` switches to it,
restarting and resuming your session. If stretches still show open, see [Limits](#limits). In the
Claude desktop app stretches are links: click one to open it in place, click `«` to close it. No
setting needed.

To update, run `claude plugin update cc-stretch@cc-stretch` in a shell, or open `/plugin`, find
cc-stretch under Installed and choose Update now. As of Claude Code 2.1.302 a plugin from this
marketplace updates on its own only once you turn on auto-update for the marketplace in `/plugin`'s
Marketplaces tab.

You read about a sixth of what Claude writes. Across 69 real replies from four of my coding
projects, the version you see before clicking was 17% of the words Claude wrote without the

replies run long, so if yours are short you will save less. How this was measured, and how to run
it on your own transcripts: [`bench/`](bench/README.md).

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# Scrawl

Show an agent a problem instead of describing it.

Press a shortcut (`⌥⇧S`) and Scrawl starts recording the screen. Talk, click around, draw on it, and press `⌥⇧S` again to finish. Scrawl records the screen, your voice, and your marks, then packs them into a compact bundle: a contact sheet of annotated keyframes (`contact-sheet.png`), individual full-resolution keyframes (`frames/frame-XX.png`), a time-aligned transcript and interaction timeline (`summary.md`), and a structured manifest (`scrawl.json`).

## Install

Scrawl needs an Apple silicon Mac on macOS 26 or later. Download the DMG from
[scrawl.kitlangton.com](https://scrawl.kitlangton.com), or use Homebrew:

```sh
brew install --cask kitlangton/tap/scrawl
```

The app updates itself (Sparkle), so Homebrew leaves updates to it.

## Agents

Install the agent skill for Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex and other agents:

```sh
bunx skills add kitlangton/scrawl
```

The `scrawl` command is the binary inside Scrawl.app. The Homebrew cask links it onto your PATH, or click
**Install** beside Command-line tool in Settings › Agents, which links it into `/opt/homebrew/bin`

new_this_month.description: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。
  把信源换成你的，把精选标准换成你的 KnowHow，它就是你的行业热点站。

  简体中文 · English

  跑起来 ·
  改成你的行业 ·
  它是怎么工作的 ·
  文档 ·
  社区交流

## 这是什么

[AIHOT](https://aihot.news) 是我做的一个 AI 热点网站。它每天从一批信源里收资料，用大模型先筛一遍、再独立打两次分，挑出真正值得看的，写成中文标题和摘要；把不同来源说的同一件事聚成一个事件，按有多少人在说排出热点；每天早上出一份日报。

这个仓库是它的引擎和框架：网站、后台、精选流程、聚簇和热度算法，**所有提示词的原文和入选门槛**，都在这里。

## 为什么开源

这半年，很多做法律、做 HR、做金融、做贵金属的朋友问我，能不能也给他们的行业做一个。

我做不了。我不懂你们的行业，不知道哪些信源有用，也不知道什么样的消息，对你们来说才叫热点。

但你们懂。

既然我没办法满足所有人，那就把火种交到大家自己手上。

## 说在前面

- **我不是专业的开发者。** 我是设计师出身，半年前还看不太懂代码。这套代码是我和 AI 一起重写的，比以前干净了很多，但一定还有写得不好的地方。发现问题欢迎提 Issue，我不一定能很快回复，先说声抱歉。
- **这是 AIHOT 的引擎。** 它和 AIHOT 线上跑的是同一份引擎代码，同步时直接从线上导出，不是精心打磨的通用框架。以后 AIHOT 的更新，我会尽量同步过来，但没法保证每一次都同步。模型榜、Codex 重置监控、主题页的大事记这些只对 AI 行业有意义的功能，以及 AIHOT 自己的运营工具，只留在 AIHOT 上。
- **里面没有 AIHOT 的信源名单和运营数据。** 仓库带了 18 个公开的海外 AI 资讯源做示范，够你跑起来看效果；真正的信源，要换成你自己行业的。
- **请不要用 AIHOT 的名字和 Logo。** 换上你自己的名字，它就是你的站。

## 它是怎么工作的

  
  

一条资料从信源进来，先判重，再预筛；可能重要的独立打两次分，写好中文标题和摘要，和别的报道聚成事件，算进热度。X 帖子没有正文或只有链接时，保留原帖的链接和图片，不调用写作或翻译模型。分数过了门槛、又不是精选里已有新闻的重复，才进精选；日报按规则编出当天要闻，周报、月报再从日报里汇编。每一步的提示词都在 [`industry/prompts/`](industry/prompts/)，改标准不用改代码。详见 [精选与校准](docs/selection.md)。

### 聚簇与热点

  
  

同一件事，官网发一篇、媒体转十篇、X 上吵一天，读者只需要看到一次。AIHOT 把它们聚成一个**事件**：先用标题摘要的向量（没配向量服务时比文字重合度）在最近两周里找候选，再让模型判断是同一件事、后续进展，还是两件事；拿不准的合并，写入前再让模型复核一遍（复核可以单独换一家模型，设 `GROUP_REVIEW_MODEL`）。

**热度**按事件算，不按文章算：48 小时内，每个独立来源只算一次，24 小时减半。重复抓取不会多算，一家媒体发十篇也只算一次，所以排在前面的，是真正有很多人在说的事。

### 速度

| | |
|---|---|
| **六种信源** | RSS、网页列表、JSON 接口、X 账号、微信公众号，以及你自己脚本推送进来的内容。信源分三

```bash
pnpm bootstrap
```

`pnpm bootstrap` 安装 workspace 依赖、准备桌面本地运行资源，再执行 `build:bootstrap`。

Agent CLI 与运行时源码位于 [apps/zcode-cli/](apps/zcode-cli/)，作为普通目录随本仓库一起克隆，无需单独拉取或初始化 Git submodule。

| 命令                           | 用途                                                              |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pnpm install`                 | 安装依赖                                                          |
| `pnpm prepare:desktop-runtime` | 准备桌面运行资源，默认包含远程资源准备                            |
| `pnpm prepare:remote-assets`   | 单独准备远程运行资源                                              |
| `pnpm bootstrap:with-remote`   | 初始化依赖、本地与远程资源，并串行构建相关包；跳过桌面应用 bundle |
| `pnpm build`                   | 递归执行各 workspace 包的构建脚本，包括包内的资源准备步骤         |

默认 `bootstrap` 跳过远程资源准备，适合本地桌面开发。使用远程工作区或验证远程发行资源时，再运行对应准备命令。

## What is this?

Ever watched a video and thought "I want one in that style, but completely my own"?

Just drop it into ReelMimic. A file, a phone recording or a YouTube link all work. Then tell it what you want to make.

First it takes the reference apart: editing rhythm, shot lengths, transitions, framing, colors and camera moves. Then
it puts together a plan for you to check. You can chat right next to it, change settings or add assets, and start
when you're happy.

Once production starts, the work is split across several AI agents. Different parts of the video are made at the same
time, and every shot is handed to a different agent to check. If something's wrong it goes back to be fixed, so it's
not a one-shot generate-and-done.

ReelMimic learns how the reference was made. It doesn't carry over the original footage, characters or assets.

The whole thing runs on your own computer, with your own Claude Code or Codex.

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# jevgrep

**Same intelligence. ~30% lower cost.**

Find code by asking what it does. In our ten-task SWE-bench comparison, Jevgrep
successfully completed the same 8 of 10 tasks as the baseline, at lower cost.

Coding agents spend part of every unfamiliar task finding the right files.
Jevgrep gives them a place to start: ask a repository question, and `jg` returns
relevant files, reading leads, and verbatim source excerpts in one stdout response.
It uses [Jev](https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/jev) to judge relevance across
folders, files, and declarations. Your coding agent then implements and tests the change.

```sh
npm install -g @dzhng/jevgrep
jg auth
jg skill
jg "How are telemetry events recorded and sent?" ./my-project
```

Requires **Node.js 22+**, **macOS, Linux, or Windows**, and a key for **Vercel AI Gateway, TypeSafe, OpenRouter, OpenCode Zen, or a custom TypeSafe-compatible endpoint**.
No separate Python, Bun, or ripgrep installation is required to use `jg`.

## Install the agent skill — required for agent setup

Installing the CLI alone does not teach your coding agent to use it. **Install
the skill as well**, from the project where your agent works:

```sh
jg skill
```

The installer detects your coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and
others) and asks where to install. Add `--global` for a user-wide install, or
`--yes` for unattended installation. The
[skill](skills/jevgrep/SKILL.md) explains installation, invocation and the meaning of returned cont

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
Other AI browser agents get captchas.
This one is invisible to anti-bots.

---

## Two ways to use this browser agent

### 1. From your assistant, over MCP

Windows, in PowerShell:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"
$env:Path = "$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin;$env:Path"
```

Linux:

```bash
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
source $HOME/.local/bin/env
```

Then install it in your assistant.

**Claude Code:**

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add feder-cr/invisible_playwright_mcp
claude plugin install invisible-playwright-mcp@feder-cr
```

**Codex:**

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add feder-cr/invisible_playwright_mcp
codex plugin add invisible-playwright-mcp@feder-cr
```

**Gemini CLI:**

```bash
gemini extensions install https://github.com/feder-cr/invisible_playwright_mcp
```

### 2. Standalone: the web UI

We bring the interface, you bring an [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) key.
Chat on the left, the live browser on the right.

Windows, in PowerShell:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"
$env:Path = "$env:USERPROFILE\.local\bin;$env:Path"
uvx invisible-playwright-mcp ui --openrouter-key sk-or-...
```

Linux:

```bash
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
source $HOME/.local/bin/env
uvx invisible-playwright-mcp ui --openrouter-key sk-or-...
```

Then open **http://127.0.0.1:8765** and type the same thing.
